follow-up time: Until discharge from the neonatal intensive care unit
study type: Secondary analysis of prospectively collected data
outcome: Coming to volume (CTV) by postpartum day 14
Provision of mother's own milk (MOM) at NICU discharge
cohort: 402 mothers of very low birth weight infants (<1500 g at birth) admitted to an urban neonatal intensive care unit
finding: Coming to volume (CTV) by day 14 postpartum was the strongest predictor of mother's own milk (MOM) feeding at NICU discharge.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with a lower likelihood of achieving CTV by postpartum day 14 (OR 0.22, 95% CI 0.08-0.63, p = 0.01).
